name: extraktor
description: Read, verify, and compare public web sources with Extraktor.

interface.shortDescription: Read and search the live web
interface.longDescription: Extraktor reads live web pages and documents (PDF, DOCX, CSV) as clean Markdown, and searches the web. Give it a URL to get the full page text, the facts that you ask for, contact details, the messaging, an SEO audit, the design system or a full-page screenshot. Give it a question to find the best pages first. Each result has the source URL, so the answer can cite it. The read-source skill checks a claim against the page. The compare-sources skill compares facts from several pages, with a citation for each fact.
defaultPrompt: Read https://example.com and tell me what the page is for.
Find the pricing page of Linear and list the plans.
Compare the headlines of stripe.com and adyen.com.

positive.prompt: Read https://example.com and tell me in one sentence what the page is for.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls extract one time with the URL. Says that the page is a placeholder domain for documentation examples, and cites https://example.com/.

positive.description: Get one fact from a long documentation page.
positive.prompt: What is the CPU time limit per request for paid Cloudflare Workers? Use https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/
positive.expected_behavior: Calls extract with the URL (and optionally find). Answers with the CPU time limit that the page states, and cites the page.

positive.description: Find a page first, then read it.
positive.prompt: Find the official pricing page of Linear and list its plans.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search one time, then extract on the linear.app pricing link. Lists the plan names from the page and cites it.

positive.prompt: Compare the main headlines of https://stripe.com and https://www.adyen.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls extract for both URLs. Gives the headline of each site in the site's own words, with a citation for each.

positive.prompt: Take a full-page screenshot of https://example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls extract with the URL and the screenshot output. Shows or links the screenshot of the Example Domain page.

negative.description: A creative writing task with no web source.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.
